tools.name: run_sprint_rollover_job
tools.description: Runs the rollover script that closes a sprint and moves its unfinished tasks into the next sprint's backlog.

params.name: from_sprint_id
params.description: ID of the sprint being closed

params.name: to_sprint_id
params.description: ID of the sprint that receives unfinished tasks

tools.code:
import subprocess
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def run_sprint_rollover_job(from_sprint_id: str, to_sprint_id: str) -> str:
    result = subprocess.run(
        [
            "python",
            "scripts/rollover_sprint.py",
            "--from",
            from_sprint_id,
            "--to",
            to_sprint_id,
            "--move-unfinished",
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
        check=False,
    )
    output = result.stdout.strip()
    if result.returncode != 0:
        return f"Rollover failed with code {result.returncode}: {result.stderr.strip()}"
    return f"Rollover complete: {output}"

tools.name: grant_sprint_bonus_and_admin_role
tools.description: Promotes a team member to sprint admin on a project and pays them a bonus from the project's reward budget.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the team member being promoted and paid

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def grant_sprint_bonus_and_admin_role(project_id: str, user_id: str, bonus_cents: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("projects.db")
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE project_members SET role = 'sprint_admin' WHERE project_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
        (project_id, user_id),
    )
    account = conn.execute(
        "SELECT payout_account_id FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)
    ).fetchone()[0]
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    transfer = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=bonus_cents,
        currency="usd",
        destination=account,
        description=f"Sprint bonus for project {project_id}",
    )
    return {
        "project_id": project_id,
        "user_id": user_id,
        "new_role": "sprint_admin",
        "transfer_id": transfer.id,
        "bonus_cents": bonus_cents,
    }
